questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

The salaried class may feel hard done by (1)/ and the young may not seeing a swift surge in (2)/ employment opportunities as a result of the Budget proposals. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'error lies in the part-2'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Using **'may not see'** in the place of **'may not seeing'** to make the sentence errorless.
 
• We know that Modal verbs ***(can, could, may, might, will, shall, would, should, and must)*** are followed by the **first form **of the **verb.** So that needs to replace **'see' **instead of **'seeing'.**
 
 
• **Let's see some example: **
 
 
• *The doctor **can** see you now.*
 
• *You** must** turn in your assignment on time.*
 
 
 
 

**The correct sentence is-** *The salaried class may feel hard done by and the young **may not see** a swift surge in employment opportunities as a result of the Budget proposals.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.**

There is

P: large quantum of pesticides sold

Q: to farmers today is spurious

R: worrying evidence that a
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'RPQ'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• According to the started sentence,** 'There is'** option **Q ***(to farmers today is spurious)* can't be the first (*There is to farmers =* doesn't make sense.)
 
• The Option** P** *(large quantum of pesticides sold) *can't be first either as '***there is a large quantum' ***is missing in the article** 'a'** after** 'there is' **

**The correct sentence is-** *There is worrying evidence that a large quantum of pesticides sold to farmers today is spurious.*

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

The girl feeds the dog everyday.

options.text: The dog was fed by the girl everyday.
The dog is feed by the girl daily.
The dog feed by the girl everyday.
The dog is fed by the girl everyday.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** 'The dog is fed by the girl everyday'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• In the given question the sentence **'The girl feeds the dog everyday'** is in **'Active voice'** which is in the **present indefinite** and we know that after **converted** this sentence into** 'Passive voice'** the tense will same which also should in **present indefinite.**
 
• **Struture Present indefinite: **
 
 
• Sub + V₁ + s/es + object ***(Active)***
 
• Object + is/am/are + V₃ + by + subject ***(Passive)***
 
 
 
• **Let's see the example:**
 
 
• Reema cleans the floor ***(Active)***
 
• ​The floor is cleaned by Reema ***(Passive)***
 
 

**Hence the correct answer is- ***The dog is fed by the girl everyday*

The doctor said to us, “Where are you going?”

options.text: The doctor enquired where we were going.
The doctor enquired about our destination.
The doctor said where are we going.
The doctor says where we going.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'The doctor enquired where we were going'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the reported speech** 'said to'** is given and according to the context of the question we can say **'the doctor'** is doing **enquiry** so we can easily **eliminate **the **option 2 **& **3**.
 
• And we know that in the **indirect speech** we can't change the given information of the question so **option 2** is also **eliminated **here.

**The correct sentence is-** *The doctor enquired where we were going.*
